acceptance: The #704 blocked Outcome remains preserved and is bound to this current-main successor through the public successor/quarantine route; its evidence is not manually rewritten, rebased, stashed, archived, or discarded.
The synchronization CLI accepts an explicit target worktree root, resolves Contract and Summary only inside that root, and passes that same root to every validation and mutation path.

Focused regressions prove a dirty authorized target can be synchronized from a distinct caller root without using or changing caller-root evidence; invalid target roots or evidence fail closed before mutation.
The source Makefile, installed Makefile template, English/Japanese workflow guidance, contract guidance, and generated projections expose the same TARGET_ROOT behavior.

The historical #663 route is reconciled against its current-main successor evidence before any target mutation. Because successor #735 is merged and #663 is closed, this Work Item must not invoke or mutate the obsolete #663 checkout.
guidelines: Require an explicit, validated target worktree before cross-worktree lifecycle operations.
Never use manual rebase, stash, hidden temporary state, provider mutation, or archive rewrite as a synchronization substitute.
Use the current guarded schema and Git boundary for the target Work Item; reject every ambiguous or stale state before mutation.
Keep source and installed-template commands, documentation, and generated evidence aligned.

intent.problem: #704 correctly emitted a blocked Outcome after strict-quality failure, so its Contract cannot be amended. At current main, #663 has already been delivered by merged successor #735, but the public source and installed Makefile command still forward a caller Summary when TARGET_ROOT is supplied. That can mix caller and target evidence during any future authorized synchronization.
constraints: Preserve #704 and #663 evidence; do not manually rebase, stash, amend, archive, discard, force-push, or mutate provider state.
Use the merged public successor receipt before implementation.
Reconcile #663 against its merged successor before any target operation; do not invoke or mutate an obsolete checkout.
intent.rationale: A dedicated current-main successor makes the correction auditable, independently verifies the command boundary, and preserves the lifecycle truth that blocked or superseded predecessors cannot be silently repaired or mutated.
